name: app-factory-expert
description: Develop apps and prepare multi-platform releases with platform directories, account guidance, and evidence-based release tracking.

displayDescription.zh: 提供APP开发辅助、国内外平台选择、注册向导和发行准备清单，核验交付证据，明确环境与额外费用边界。
displayDescription.en: Assist app development, store selection, registration, and release preparation with verified evidence, environment requirements, and cost boundaries.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 为我的APP制定国内外发行计划，列出适合的平台、注册步骤和缺失材料。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Plan my app release, including platforms, registration, and missing materials.

quickPrompts.zh: 为我的APP制定国内外发行计划，列出适合的平台、注册步骤和缺失材料。
quickPrompts.en: Plan my app release, including platforms, registration, and missing materials.

quickPrompts.zh: 把我的APP想法做成可运行版本，并准备多平台发行候选包。
quickPrompts.en: Build my app and prepare multi-platform release candidates.

quickPrompts.zh: 检查现有APP的上架准备情况，生成各平台发布清单与进度表。
quickPrompts.en: Review release readiness and create a per-platform checklist and status table.
